docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
You can find all possible commands to use in the Twitch Chat here.

The commands are seperated into the following categories:

docs.title: Fun
docs.text: Interactions with other viewers or the streamer.

docs.title: General
docs.text: Commands that are used regularly.

docs.title: Utility
docs.text: Polls, dice rolls and more.

docs.title: acceptbattle
docs.text:
Accept a battle when you were challenged.

UsageExample 
!acceptbattle

Input:

!acceptbattle
Output: 
{username} launches an epic strike on flawb3rry and emerges victorious! 🏆

docs.title: battle
docs.text:
Challenge another user to a battle.

UsageExample 
!battle <username>

Input:

!battle flawb3rry
Output: 
{username} has challenged flawb3rry to a duel! Type !acceptbattle to join the battle!

docs.title: dailyfact
docs.text:
Get the daily fact.

UsageExample 
!dailyfact

Input:

!dailyfact
Output: 
Todays fact: Cats are cool.

docs.title: endriot
docs.text:
Ends a riot.

UsageExample 
!endriot

Input:

 !endriot
Output: 
{username} ended the riot.

docs.title: riot
docs.text:
Starts or joins a riot.

UsageExample 
!riot

Input:

 !riot
Output: 
{username} started a riot!

docs.title: hug
docs.text:
Hug another user.

UsageExample 
!hug <username>

Input:

 !hug flawb3rry
Output: 
{username} gives flawb3rry a hug!

docs.title: checkin
docs.text:
Lets you build up a watch streak by checking in at consecutive streams.

UsageExample 
!checkin

Input:

!checkin
Output: 
{username} has checked in 20 times in a row! You're on fire!

docs.title: followage
docs.text:
Shows how long you have been following the channel.

UsageExample 
!followage

Input:

!followage
Output: 
{username}, you have been following this channel for 0 years, 3 months, and 5 days.

docs.title: raid
docs.text:
Displays the raid message.

UsageExample 
!raid

Input:

!raid
Output: 
🍓🍓🍓Flawberry Raid🍓🍓🍓

docs.title: 8ball
docs.text:
Get a randomized answer to your question.

UsageExample 
!8ball <question>

Input:

!8ball Is this a cool documentation?
Output: 
Absolutely!

docs.title: coin
docs.text:
Flip a coin.

UsageExample 
!coin

Input:

!coin
Output: 
{username}, you flipped heads!

docs.title: endpoll
docs.text:
This command can only be used by mods

End an ongoing poll and display the result.

UsageExample 
!endpoll

Input:

 !endpoll
Output: 
Poll results for: Is Squirtle the best Pokémon?
Yes: 10 votes
No: 0 votes

docs.title: endpredict
docs.text:
This command can only be used by mods

End an ongoing poll and display the result. If no value is written the prediction defaults to "false".

UsageExample 
!endpredict <true | false>

Input:

 !endpoll
Output: 
Prediction Results for: Can I beat the next level?
Outcome: True
Gussed correctly (3): {user1}, {user2}, {user3}
Guessed incorrectly (1): {user4}

docs.title: guess
docs.text:
Take a guess on the currently ongoing prediction.

UsageExample 
!guess <true | false>

Input:

 !guess true
Output: 
{user} your guess of "true" has been recorded!

docs.title: lookup
docs.text:
Look up a term on various sites.

UsageExample 
!lookup <wikipedia | urban> <term>

Input:

 !lookup wikipedia cat
Output: 
The cat (Felis catus), also referred to as the domestic cat, is a small domesticated carnivorous mammal.

docs.title: poll
docs.text:
This command can only be used by mods

Start a poll with multiple options.

UsageExample 
!poll <question> | <answer1> | <answer2> | <answer n>

Input:

!poll Is this a question? | Yes | No | Maybe | I don't know | Can you repeat the question?
Output: 
 📊 New poll: Is this a question?
 Option 1: Yes
 Option 2: No
 Option 3: Maybe
 Option 4: I don't know
 Option 5: Can you repeat the question?
 Vote by typing !vote [option number]

docs.title: predict
docs.text:
This command can only be used by mods

Start a prediction with only true or false options.

UsageExample 
!predict <question>

Input:

!predict Will I beat the next level?
Output: 
 🔮 Prediction: Will I beat the next level?
 "Make your guess by typing !guess true or !guess false."

docs.title: remindme
docs.text:
Set a reminder for minutes or hours.

UsageExample 
!remindme <number><m | h> <message>

Input:

!remindme 10m Don't forget to hydrate!
Output: 
 {user},  I'll remind you in 10m.

 {user}, here's your reminder: Don't forget to hydrate!

docs.title: roll
docs.text:
Roll one or multiple dice.

UsageExample

Amount can be ommitted for 1.

!roll <amount><type>

Input:

!roll 2d20
Output: 
 {user} rolled 2d20: [19, 10] - Total: 29

docs.title: translate
docs.text:
Translate a sentence.

UsageExample

Punctuaton is important.

!translate <origin language> <target language> <text>

Input:

!translate en de This is a sentence.
Output: 
 {user}, translation: Das ist ein Satz.

docs.title: vote
docs.text:
Cast a vote on the currently ongoing poll.

UsageExample 
!vote <number>

Input:

!vote 1
Output: 
 {user}, your vote for "Yes" has been recorded!
